$comment: Per-state, per-section requirements. Rows marked observed_baseline need owner approval before they justify restructuring a page. Each row names its source, owner, checks and exemplar status.

campus.hero.identity.content: H1 "Alpha <Campus>"; subtitle "<grade range> Private School in <City>, <State>" with the HubSpot grade range and the HubSpot city/state.
campus.hero.identity.source: HubSpot Programs (name, grade range, city, state); decision 2026-09-15 that HubSpot is the source of truth

campus.hero.ctas.content: CTA row: STAY IN-THE-KNOW, Attend an Info Session, Book a Call, Apply now. Each resolves to a reachable, campus-specific destination.
campus.hero.ctas.source: demonstrated-correct pages (44 of 44 carry the first three; 39 carry Book a Call)
campus.hero.ctas.ownerWhenMissing: campus admissions owner for destinations; Elementor owner for a missing button

campus.intro.status-sentence.content: "Alpha <Campus> is open and enrolling." as the first sentence of the intro text widget, followed by the "Join us for an info session" paragraph. No launch-era wording anywhere on the page: Coming Soon, Coming Fall, Launching, Opening <season>.
campus.intro.status-sentence.source: HubSpot state Open (decision 2026-09-15); wording from exemplars Plano and Scottsdale; requirement catalog rule on stale launch copy

campus.intro.media.content: Intro card slot shows this campus's approved open-state media: the "<Campus> Open and Enrolling" card from the September 7 template set, or an approved campus video. Never a launch-era graphic, another campus's image, or unrelated footage.
campus.intro.media.source: registry/campus-open-media.json; requirement catalog rule on launch media and approved video
campus.intro.media.ownerWhenMissing: Yash Chitneni (cards); Matt or Yash (video approval)

campus.intro.heading.content: "Welcome to the Future of Education in <City>"
campus.intro.heading.note: The word "education" is on MacKenzie's hold list; do not rewrite this heading until she decides.

site.header.rendered.content: Theme-builder header with stylesheet, logo, navigation, Contact Us; footer present.

campus.resources.packet.required: when an approved current packet exists
campus.resources.packet.content: Info packet CTA links to a public, logged-out-reachable document for this campus and school year.
campus.resources.packet.source: requirement catalog; group A replay found 401s on Oklahoma City, South Bay LA, Tulsa
campus.resources.packet.ownerWhenMissing: info_packet path: campus requester + marketing-collateral + brand-authority + expansion-founding + website-operations (packet-owner person is an open gap; not Dmitry Bakaev)

campus.top-section.content: Optional. Its absence alone is not a defect. Visible content still follows source, brand and seasonal rules.
campus.top-section.source: Live inventory: present on 29 of 44 campus pages

campus.founding-families.content: Parent-proof section remains present when the approved template includes it; videos and claims are approved and playable.
campus.founding-families.source: Live inventory: present on 44 of 44 campus pages

campus.events.content: Campus event strip is scoped to the exact HubSpot program-interest label and public events match HubSpot.
campus.events.source: HubSpot event-import contract and live page model

campus.contact-resources.content: Address, phone, email, map and CTAs come from their field-specific source; optional controls appear only with a verified destination.

campus.team.content: Only approved current staff cards with exact name, public title, biography, photo and order. No placeholders or crossed photos.
campus.team.source: APEX staff request, campus role owner and staff-card safety contract

campus.video-gallery.content: Approved Alpha and campus-relevant records imported from Airtable; no wrong-campus or sister-brand content.
campus.video-gallery.source: Airtable video pipeline and identity rules

campus.photo-gallery.content: Visible images have rights, campus identity, alt text and an acceptable crop.
campus.photo-gallery.source: approved media source and proposed media standard

campus.lower-section.content: Approved template structure with no stale launch, seasonal, cross-brand or unapproved claim content.
campus.lower-section.source: Live inventory: present on 42 of 44 pages; site rules

campus.accreditation.content: Candidate and accredited badge states reflect cognia_accredited and cannot be visibly inconsistent.

campus.discovery.content: Unique title and description, canonical, semantic H1, indexable state, School schema matching source facts, sitemap entry and approved Markdown and LLM behavior.
campus.discovery.source: site search rules and HubSpot campus facts

campus.intro.status-sentence.content: A launch statement naming the month or season and the year, for example "Alpha Bethesda opens January 2027." "Coming soon" alone is a defect.
campus.intro.status-sentence.source: APEX ticket cmsuma22l000804juh8fq4nrs (Alpha Bethesda, rachel@alpha.school, August 2026); requirement catalog
campus.intro.status-sentence.ownerWhenMissing: program record owner for the date

campus.page-existence.content: Any published page is canonical, intentionally indexable and complete enough for parents. A public page is not required solely because the Program is Announced.
campus.page-existence.source: HubSpot lifecycle meaning and launch owner

campus.hero.identity.content: H1, grade and location identity match the exact HubSpot Program.

campus.hero.ctas.content: Only approved destinations appear. Apply, booking, event, packet and Community controls are conditional on verified routes.

campus.intro.media.content: Approved launch-stage media for this campus and date; no other campus, expired season or open-state claim.

campus.events.content: If present, the strip is scoped to the exact HubSpot program-interest label.

campus.contact-resources.content: Only verified public facts and destinations are shown. Missing values are not invented.

campus.team.content: Any visible person has an approved name, public title, biography, photo and effective date.
campus.team.source: APEX staff request and campus owner

campus.discovery.content: Canonical, metadata, H1, indexability, schema, sitemap, Markdown and LLM behavior are explicit for the launch page.

campus.page-existence.content: No public campus WordPress page is required. Any internal draft stays unpublished, noindex and absent from sitemap, Markdown and LLM exports.

campus.map-community.content: One approved map pin for the exact Program routes to a visible Community program through https://www.community.alpha.school/?campus=<slug>.
campus.map-community.ownerWhenMissing: growth-map-owner or community-app-owner by failing surface

campus.public-claims.content: Do not publish Apply, booking, packet, event, tuition, grade, opening-date or staff claims without an approved source and launch-stage rule.
